instruction: A mountain shrine to a phoenix at dusk: a gilded phoenix statue with wings spread atop a stone altar, drifting ember particles rising like feathers, a path of vermilion torii gates climbing the slope, stone braziers with dancing flames, autumn maples shedding red leaves, prayer plaques on a rack, and a warm glow pulsing from the statue's chest.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Phoenix Ember Shrine. A mountain shrine to a phoenix at dusk: a gilded phoenix statue with wings spread atop a stone altar, drifting ember particles rising like feathers, a path of vermilion torii gates climbing the slope, stone braziers with dancing flames, autumn maples shedding red leaves, prayer plaques on a rack, and a warm glow pulsing from the statue's chest. Style: fiery ceremonial fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
